name: ai-enabler
description: Machine-driven delivery from a Jira ticket to a pull request, without spec-driven development, plus measured KPIs of AI usage (human interaction, time and cost).

plugins.name: ai-enabler
plugins.description: Jira ticket to pull request: intake through the Jira MCP server, repository analysis, plan, implementation, tests with a coverage threshold, independent parallel review with auto-fix, and shipping. Two human gates: the plan and the ship.

plugins.name: ai-enabler-kpi
plugins.description: Opt-in hooks that capture human interaction, AI working time and token usage, and a report skill that turns them into KPIs and cost in USD per session, user, ticket, skill and model.
